title: Grade 2 Science — Tue, Jun 10
description: Animals Around Us — Day 2 of 5: Body parts and movement
subject: science

questions.question: Birds use ____ to fly.
questions.explanation: Birds have wings that help them fly through the air.

questions.question: Fish use ____ to swim in water.
questions.explanation: Fish have fins that help them balance and move through water.

questions.question: A dog uses its ____ to walk and run.
questions.explanation: Dogs have four strong legs that help them walk, run, and jump.

questions.question: Which body covering keeps a bird warm and helps it fly?
questions.explanation: Feathers keep birds warm and light, and their wings are covered with feathers for flying.

questions.question: Fish are covered with:
questions.explanation: Fish are covered with scales that protect their bodies and help them move smoothly through water.

questions.question: A snake moves by:
questions.explanation: Snakes have no legs. They move by slithering — using muscles to push their body along the ground.

questions.question: How many legs does an insect have?
questions.explanation: All insects have exactly 6 legs. Examples: ant, butterfly, bee, and beetle.

questions.question: A frog can move by:
options: Both hopping on land and swimming in water
questions.explanation: Frogs have long back legs for hopping on land and webbed feet for swimming in water.

questions.question: Which body part helps a monkey grip branches?
options: Hands and feet with fingers and toes
questions.explanation: Monkeys have hands and feet with long fingers and toes that help them grip and swing on branches.

questions.question: Cats and dogs are covered with:
questions.explanation: Cats, dogs, and most other mammals are covered with fur (or hair) which keeps them warm.

questions.question: Which body part does a bird use to catch food?
questions.explanation: Birds use their beak to catch, pick up, and eat food. Different birds have different beak shapes for different foods.

questions.question: An earthworm moves by:
questions.explanation: Earthworms have no legs. They move by stretching the front part forward, then pulling the back part along.

questions.question: Which animal moves the fastest on land?
questions.explanation: The cheetah is the fastest land animal. It uses its long legs and flexible spine to run at great speed.

questions.question: A turtle uses its ____ to swim.
questions.explanation: Sea turtles have flippers (paddle-like limbs) that help them swim through water.

questions.question: Which of these animals moves on two legs?
questions.explanation: Hens (and other birds) walk on two legs. Dogs, cows, and elephants walk on four legs.
